records.context: The ``+1`` in both places is not a fudge: including the observed configuration in its own reference set is what makes the test EXACT, giving ``P(p <= alpha) <= alpha`` under the null for any ``B``. It also sets a floor of ``1 / (B + 1)`` -- with the default 200,000 permutations, 5e-06. A guide at the floor is one no permutation reached, and guides there cannot be ranked against each other; raising ``B`` is the only remedy and costs linearly. The ``eps`` keeps a permutation that reproduces the observed statistic exactly from failing its own ``>=``.

It also sets a floor of ``1 / (B + 1)`` -- with the default 200,000 permutations, 5e-06. records.translation: 两处的 ``+1`` 都不是任意修正：将观测到的配置纳入其自身的参考集，使检验保持精确，即在原假设成立时满足 ``P(p <= alpha) <= alpha``，且该结论对任意 ``B`` 均成立。这也将最小值设为 ``1 / (B + 1)`` -- 使用默认的 200,000 次置换时，该值为 5e-06。达到该最小值的向导序列表示没有任何置换达到相应统计量，因此这些向导序列之间无法排序；唯一的解决方法是增大 ``B``，计算成本会线性增加。``eps`` 可避免恰好复现观测统计量的置换因其自身的 ``>=`` 比较而被错误排除。

records.source: optional callable asked before each channel's Cellpose model construction and forward pass. When it answers True the work is abandoned by raising :class:`OutlineCancelled` rather than finishing a page nobody is waiting for; ``'otsu'`` outlines are fast enough that they are never interrupted mid-channel.
records.translation: 在为每个图像数据通道构建 Cellpose 模型并执行前向传播之前调用的可选函数。如果该函数返回 True，则通过引发 :class:`OutlineCancelled` 放弃该任务，而不是完成无人等待的页面；``'otsu'`` 轮廓计算足够快，因此不会在单个图像数据通道处理途中被中断。

records.context: Dropping a column that no visible row fills is safe because it carries no value for this selection: "how many microplate sample positions hold this guide" has no answer for a gene. The identity and significance columns in :data:`TABLE_KEEP_COLUMNS` stay regardless.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.regression_results.for_table#2
records.source: Dropping a column that no visible row fills is safe because it carries no value for this selection: "how many wells hold this guide" has no answer for a gene. The identity and significance columns in :data:`TABLE_KEEP_COLUMNS` stay regardless.
records.translation: 删除所有可见行均为空的列是安全的，因为该列对当前选择不包含任何值：“有多少个微孔板样本位置包含此向导序列”这一问题不适用于基因。无论如何，:data:`TABLE_KEEP_COLUMNS` 中的标识列和显著性列都会保留。
